liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **brokedown(take 1)**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 8 archived performances [14]
- **brokedown(take 2)**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 8 archived performances [14]
- **cumberland (take 2)**: back after 137 archived shows (601 days); rare: 4 archived performances [14]
- Earliest performances in the archive: saturday night (take 1), saturday night (take 2) [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-09-29.unsurpassed-masters-vol4-vol6.116951.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 16 songs; 90 min [1]
- **gd71-09-29.sbd.cousinit.16891.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 66 min; rated 2.27/5 by 11 [2]. Said about its sound: Tape speed issues create messy moments throughout the recording; Organ is played a little low in the mix on this track; The recording sounds like crap, making it hard to listen to [4][5][9][11][12]

## Around the show

- Band wanted keyboard texture to continue after Pig Pen's health issues [8]
- Garcia appears to ask for beer around the forty-second mark [10]
- Keith Godchaux's first show with the Dead occurred three weeks later [13]
- This rehearsal marks a decisive step affecting the band's sound for a decade [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-09-29.unsurpassed-masters-vol4-vol6.116951.flac16**: source: flac16 Bootleg CDs "Unsurpassed Master Vol 4" And "Unsurpassed Master Vol 6" > EAC > Wav > FLAC [1]. Also: Bootlegs from label Dead Man are described as 1971 studio outtakes [1]
- **gd71-09-29.sbd.cousinit.16891.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Transfer lineage is MSR to C to DAT to WAV to SHN [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Popdose: [Test of the Boomerang: Soundchecks, Rehearsals and Outtakes, Part Two - Popdose](https://popdose.com/test-of-the-boomerang-soundchecks-rehearsals-and-outtakes-part-two/) [15]
